_comment: Per-window ORB parameters. Times are in US/Eastern (US options clock). GMT equivalents in summer (EDT=GMT-4): Asia 00:00-06:00, London 07:00-12:30, New York 13:30-20:00. In winter (EST=GMT-5) add one hour. use_trailing_stop (default false): after +trail_activate_r R of profit, cancel TP and trail stop trail_distance_r under the peak (floor at breakeven). Global kill-switch: TRAILING_STOPS_ENABLED=0.
